portfolio.description: Per-class best fleet, equal-weight across classes. CRYPTO:gpt4o(n=48); EQUITY:claude_haiku_4_5(n=15); FOREX:deepseek_r1(n=14); COMMODITY:command_a(n=13); ETF:grok3(n=43); BOND:claude_haiku_4_5(n=14)
portfolio.methodology: Aggregated from ai_tournament_picks_latest.json (resolved WIN/LOSS/TP_HIT/SL_HIT). Eligibility gate: n>=20, WR>=50%, PF>=1.1. Reliability scored by composite = 0.5*Wilson95LB(WR) + 0.3*PF_LB/3 + 0.2*(1-exp(-n/50)). Position weights synthesize paper allocations against $100k starting NAV. NOT promoted to live money; tracked as shadow paper only per CLAUDE.md Goal #1. Variant: per-asset-class top fleet by Wilson-LB; classes equal-weighted.
